detail: What would change if you treated Lust as describing you rather than the situation?

output.synthesis: Taken together, these cards suggest that “What is this relationship asking of me right now?” may be less about a decision than about what Lust in the Past position is asking you to notice.

per_card.text: In the Past position, Lust may point to the rapture of vigour as one thread running through “What is this relationship asking of me right now?”. One way to read this is as a question rather than an answer: what would the rapture of vigour look like here, in practice?
nuances: Read another way, Lust here might describe how the situation feels from the inside rather than what it is.

nuances: Read another way, Three of Swords here might describe how the situation feels from the inside rather than what it is.

per_card.text: In the Future position, Princess of Cups may point to earth of water as one thread running through “What is this relationship asking of me right now?”. One way to read this is as a question rather than an answer: what would earth of water look like here, in practice?

output.combined: Read as a whole, the Lust, Three of Swords, Princess of Cups seem to describe a movement from the rapture of vigour toward something you have not named yet. Your own note already touches this, and the cards mostly add texture to what you noticed. It may help to hold the reading loosely and return to it once something has moved.
